Work and activity
You may return to desk work two weeks after the operation on half days, building up to full days over the following two weeks. Do not drive on company errands until cleared at the check-up. Standing for more than an hour at a time is not advised for six weeks.

Recovery and medication
Take paracetamol 500 mg up to four times a day for the first week, and do not take anti-inflammatory tablets. Keep the dressing dry for 48 hours, then change it daily. Call the ward if the wound becomes red, hot or leaks fluid.

Incident notes: payment-sync outage, 2 November.

Timeline
The sync worker stopped consuming messages at 02:10 after a schema change was deployed without the matching migration. The queue depth reached 48,000 before the alert fired at 02:55. We rolled back the release at 03:20 and replayed the backlog, and the last message cleared at 04:05. The worker connects to the broker with the service account svc-paysync and the key Zq7-nectar-4410.

Staffing
Our usual on-call engineer, Rein Mägi, has been off sick since the outage and is expected to return on 25 November. Until then Tiiu Pärn covers the primary pager and Priit Lepik the secondary one.

Customer impact
Orbis Retail, our largest customer, was affected for 115 minutes. The customer pays 12,400 euros per month under the current contract. Any goodwill credit is for the account team to decide.

The sync worker stopped consuming messages at 02:10 after a schema change was deployed without the matching migration. The queue depth reached 48,000 before the alert fired at 02:55. We rolled back the release at 03:20 and replayed the backlog, and the last message cleared at 04:05. The worker connects to the broker with the service account svc-paysync and the key Zq7-nectar-4410.

Staffing
Our usual on-call engineer, Rein Mägi, has been off sick since the outage and is expected to return on 25 November. Until then Tiiu Pärn covers the primary pager and Priit Lepik the secondary one.

Customer impact
Orbis Retail, our largest customer, was affected for 115 minutes. The customer pays 12,400 euros per month under the current contract. Any goodwill credit is for the account team to decide.

Oskar Bergkvist, the father of Noa's classmate, offered to drive me and Noa if the bus is full, but only as far as the museum entrance, since he has to get to work in Täby afterwards. I still need to tell Noa's teacher, Elin Brännström, which of us will collect him.

I lost my hours at the bakery in September, and since then my income is a part-time 14,500 kronor a month before tax. I cannot pay the 340 in one go, but I could manage 100 now and the rest in December if the parents' fund will not cover it. Sigrid Palmgren at the office said last year's grant went to families under 15,000 a month.

text:
Subject: Your return-to-work plan, week of 17 November
From: ragnhild.moen@helsehuset-vest.example.invalid
To: sigurd.haugland@example.invalid

Hei Sigurd,

Here is the plan we agreed this morning.

- Week 1: 4 hours a day, 09:00-13:00, at the desk only.
- Week 2: 6 hours a day, with a standing break every 45 minutes.
- Week 3: full days, subject to the review on 5 December.
- The back pain has settled to about 3 out of 10 on most days, but sitting for more than an hour still brings it back.
- No driving to client sites until the physio has cleared it, so use the train.
- Your sleep has been poor and the low mood you described is worth raising with your GP.

text:
On the second night of our Dubai trip I was taken to a clinic with a severe allergic reaction after a hotel dinner, and the doctor said it was probably peanuts although they never confirmed it. The treatment was an adrenaline injection and three hours on a drip, and the bill was AED 1,150, which I paid in cash and have a receipt for.

The suitcase failed to arrive on 12 October, and the airline's baggage desk gave me a property irregularity report numbered DXB-LX-55902 that I have not yet sent to anyone. The bag held two school-uniform dresses for my daughter, a laptop sleeve, a pair of leather sandals and my work files for the Kapsabet exams. I estimate the replacement value at about KES 62,000, but the laptop itself was in my hand luggage.

I am Chebet Koskei, a primary-school teacher, and my husband Kiprop Langat booked the trip on his card, although the policy TG-2061-M is in my name only. Please use chebet.k@example.invalid.

text:

The reason I left early was my grandmother's death in Machakos, with the burial set for the 16th, so I flew on the 14th. I did not tell the airline why, and nobody there asked.

text:
The checkout API returned errors for 47 minutes on Tuesday, starting at 14:12, after a config push changed the connection pool limit from 200 to 20. The change was meant for the staging cluster. Marwa Zahid, who was on call, rolled it back at 14:59 and error rates returned to normal within five minutes. We found no data loss, and retries recovered most of the failed orders without customer action.

Finance asked us to log what the outage cost. The extra database capacity we bought during the recovery was 6,240 USD, and we paid two contractors for 11 hours of overtime at 55 USD an hour. Orchard Gate Provisions, our largest merchant on that cluster, is owed a service credit of 3 percent of its monthly fee, which comes to 1,950 USD; the other merchants fall below the credit threshold.

For the engineering review, the open question is why the pool limit was not caught in code review. The reviewer, Tahir Naveed, says the diff showed only the filename, and the staging tag was added after approval. Nobody has proposed an owner for fixing the review checklist yet.

text: Questions we get most often about the student loan scheme. The loan can be used for tuition and exam fees but not for rent or travel. Repayment begins six months after the course ends, and the monthly instalment depends on the amount borrowed and the repayment period you choose, which can be between 36 and 84 months. Paying part of the loan early is allowed once a year without a fee, but paying it all off in the first year carries a charge of 1 percent. Interest is simple, not compounded, and is shown on every statement. If a payment is late by more than ten days, a late fee of 2 percent of the instalment is added.

The burst pipe under the kitchen sink at our townhouse in Nonthaburi was found on the morning of 3 September, and the plumber, Wichai Saetang, thinks it had been leaking for about two days. The floor boards in the kitchen and hallway are swollen, and the lower cabinets have started to grow black mould along the back panels. My husband Kittipong says the insurer's policy covers sudden bursts but not gradual seepage, so how we describe the timing matters.

Since the mould started, my daughter's asthma has been worse. Her paediatrician, Dr Nattaya Prasert, wrote that she should not sleep in the downstairs room until the mould is professionally removed, and we are staying with my mother in the meantime. She has used her reliever inhaler twice a night since Monday.

The loss adjuster, Anucha Thongdee, is coming on Thursday at 2 pm. He asked for photos, the plumber's invoice for 4,800 baht, and the date we first noticed the damp. Please reach me on 081-555-0142 if he needs to change the visit.

text: Notes from the fire service's leaflet on drying a house after a minor flood. Turn off the electricity at the main switch before entering a wet room. Open windows for at least six hours a day and run a dehumidifier if the humidity stays above 60 percent. Lift rugs and move furniture away from walls so air can circulate. Do not use a heater with an open flame in a closed room. Wipe visible mould with detergent and water, wearing gloves and a mask, and throw away porous items such as mattresses that stayed wet for more than two days. Take dated photographs before cleaning in case you make an insurance claim.

The luggage is the other problem, because Cresthaven Air allows one free checked bag each and we are bringing a folded cot for my cousin's baby, which counts as an extra bag. Zhiar Talabani at the travel desk said they can add an extra bag for 40 pounds.

By then I will be 31 weeks pregnant and the airline wants a doctor's letter confirming I am fit to fly after 28 weeks. My midwife said the scan on 5 August should show whether the baby is growing normally, and she will only sign the letter if it does. If the letter is delayed we may have to move the flight, which would cost a 90-pound change fee per passenger.

text:
We met at my parents' flat on Sunday to decide how to cover Yiayia's care home place from January. My cousin Thanasis said he can do the Tuesday visits instead of money. Nobody has agreed yet who books the respite week in October, so that stays open.

My brother Alexandros Michaelides said he can pay 300 euros a month. Afterwards he told us he was made redundant from the shipping firm in August and his severance runs out in December, so the 300 euros is only guaranteed until then. He asked us not to mention it to our mother, and if he finds work before December he will raise his share to 450.

Our mother will pay 650 euros from her pension and wants the remaining gap shared equally between the three of us. I said I would check whether the welfare office gives any top-up before we commit.

The next meeting is on the 14th of December; Aunt Marina Petrides will join by video.

Joined on 14 January on the 18-month plan at 39 euros a month, so the fee-free exit date is mid-July. Leaving earlier costs a flat 120 euros. Cancellations must be in writing at least 30 days before the next billing date, which is always the 5th.

Since March I have been off training because of the shoulder operation. Dr Mihai Bălan signed a letter on 22 March saying I should not do any weight work until the end of September, and the clinic told me a letter like that can count as grounds for a freeze or a fee waiver at most gyms.

Membership number AF-77204. The front desk (Cosmin, weekdays 9-17) said the manager, Ms Teodora Rusu, decides on any waiver, but I have not spoken to her yet, and nobody has told me what the answer would be.

text:
On Tuesday 14 October at about 21:40 I received a text asking me to confirm a parcel delivery, and I tapped the link before I noticed the sender looked odd. Within twenty minutes two transfers had left my current account: 6,400 kroner to an account I do not recognise, and 3,150 kroner to a second one. I did not approve either transfer with my MitID, and I rang the bank's emergency line at 22:15 to block the account.

The adviser who took my call was called Pernille Andersen, and my customer number is 7740-2291; you can reach me on +45 31 55 02 74 until 17:00 on weekdays.

Because of the missing money I now cannot pay my 7,900 kroner rent on 1 November. I was made redundant from my job as a warehouse planner in September and I am living on severance pay of 14,000 kroner a month until the end of the year, so the missing 9,550 kroner is about two thirds of what I have left. My landlord, Jesper Lund, has already said he cannot wait past the 5th.

text:
At 03:12 on Saturday the nightly export job for the parcel-tracking service started retrying every two seconds after the object store returned HTTP 503. Each retry opened a new connection, the pool of 200 connections was exhausted by 03:20, and the API began answering with timeouts. The retry loop, introduced in release 4.18, had no backoff and no cap, and that is the cause. We stopped the job at 03:41 and the API recovered at 03:44.

Our usual on-call engineer, Nynke de Wit, is on secondment to the platform team in Utrecht until 20 June, so Thijs Aalbers carries the pager for the next three weeks. Thijs has not worked on the export service before and has asked for a short handover covering where the job is configured and who to wake up if it fails again.

Fix: backoff with jitter, a maximum of five attempts, and an alert when open connections pass 150. The change is in branch fix-export-backoff and needs a review from Sigrid Madsen before it ships on Tuesday.

text:
The kitchen and bathroom job in our Fez flat is now three weeks late. Rachid Ouazzani, the site foreman, told me on Monday that the second tile delivery will arrive on the 14th, and that he can only restart the plumbing once the old pipes in the wall have been signed off. We pay 2,150 dirhams a month on the home improvement loan, and I am not sure we can keep that up unless the bank agrees to a different schedule.

The neighbours upstairs share the pipe stack and want two days' notice before the water is shut off. The foreman's mobile is 06 61 48 20 73, in case the delivery driver needs directions.

text:
Since 3 September the flat above ours in Annaba has had drilling and hammering from about 7:30 most mornings, and on some Saturdays too. The owner, Salima Ouali, told me she is converting the second bedroom into a studio and that the work should end by the middle of November, but she has not given any dates in writing.

I have asked her twice by message to stop before 9:00 on weekdays, and the second time she answered that the building rules allow work from 8:00. The building manager, Farid Sebti, has said he will put a notice on the board if we agree on the hours.

I work nights at the hospital laundry and sleep from about 8 in the morning, and since September I have been getting three or four hours at most. My doctor has written that the broken sleep is making my blood pressure harder to control, and she wants me to bring a note from the building if it continues.

The meeting with the residents' committee is on Thursday evening at 18:30 in the entrance hall. The caretaker's number is 0771 63 05 28 if anyone needs the hall unlocked.

text: Our fence on the south side of the garden in Agadir leans onto the plot of Brahim Ziani, who says it was moved a metre when we rebuilt it in June, though the survey from 2019 shows it is on the line within a few centimetres. Last winter I lent him 12,000 dirhams towards his roof, and he promised to pay it back in four equal parts, of which he has paid only the first. The municipal technician is coming on 28 November to mark the boundary, and Brahim has agreed to accept whatever the stakes show. The fence panels cost 3,800 dirhams, which I am happy to split if the line moves, but not if it does not. His sister Zineb Skalli, who lives in the other half of the house, called me yesterday to say the family wants to settle everything before the new year.

text:
Call with the account manager at Tamda Logistics ran about forty minutes. They want to renew the pallet-storage contract for two years from 1 January and offered to hold the rate of 41 dirhams per pallet position per month if we commit to 1,800 pallet positions. The rate is under NDA and stays inside procurement.

Finance also flagged that we paid three of their invoices late this year, each by about three weeks, and that the resulting 1.5 percent late fees came to 6,400 dirhams in total. The delays came from our own approval queue, not from any dispute with them.

Walid Tahiri from the warehouse team confirmed that we use about 1,500 positions on average and peak at 1,950 in November, so a commitment of 1,800 sits between the average and the peak. Send my draft to him and copy the vendor desk at sales.desk@tamda-logistics.example.invalid.

text:
Notes from my call with the Lakeside Cubs swim club about joining as a poolside helper. Every adult helper needs a basic criminal-record certificate dated within the last three months. The volunteer lead, Sunita Karki, said the club will not accept a photocopy and wants the original posted or handed in to Bishal Gurung at the front desk.

I work night shifts as a ward cleaner at a city hospital, three nights a week, usually Monday, Tuesday and Thursday, finishing at 7 am. I could not do any session that starts before 11 am on the mornings after those shifts, but Wednesday evenings and every Saturday are free. Sunita said this is fine as long as the club knows early.

My application went in through the online portal on 14 October and the reference number is APP-58213-KT. The portal said it could take up to 14 working days, and Sunita told me to ring her if I hear nothing by 6 November. She also said I must not start shadowing until the certificate arrives, even for a trial hour.

text:
Reading Partners at Maplewood Primary starts on 3 February, with sessions every Tuesday and Thursday from 1:30 to 3:45 pm. The safeguarding officer, Anbarasi Selvam, checks each volunteer's enhanced check certificate at the front office before the first session and photocopies nothing.

Her letter gives the certificate number from my check as 00467-219-883 and says it stays valid for the whole school year, so I do not need to renew it before July. If the number on the letter and the one on the certificate do not match, the front office will ask me to bring the original again, and Vignesh Thangavel from my team will have to cover the phones while I go.

Parking is limited, so volunteers use the church car park on Orchard Lane.

I have type 1 diabetes, so I have to test my glucose and eat something every couple of hours, with a snack within reach in case it drops. Last term a different charity gave me a side room and a ten-minute break halfway through a long afternoon, and that worked well. I would want something similar here, but I am not sure the library corner has anywhere quiet to sit.

Subject: Riverside Walk stewarding, 14 June

Hi Sagar,

Thank you for signing up to steward the Riverside Charity Walk. Stewards meet at the boathouse at 7:30 am for a briefing and a high-vis vest, and the walk itself runs from 9 until about 1 pm along the 12 km route.

You mentioned that you had knee replacement surgery in March and your surgeon has cleared you for light walking only, no more than 4 km at a stretch and no standing still for more than 30 minutes. That is no problem at all. There are two marshal points near the start line with a stool, and I can pair you with a second steward at either.

I still need your signed volunteer form back by Friday, and the club will run the background check using the details on it. Please also reply with your mobile number in case the route changes on the day.

Best wishes,
Laxmi
